hotel.name: The Langham Huntington, Pasadena, Los Angeles

verified_facts.text: The covered Picture Bridge has been a feature of the hotel since 1932.
verified_facts.excerpt: has been a charming feature of the hotel since 1932.

verified_facts.text: The Picture Bridge displays 41 replica oil paintings of California landscapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admire the 41 replica oil paintings set in this dynamic museum.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's classic architecture and landscape were designed by the same key figures as the nearby Huntington Library.
verified_facts.excerpt: with classic architecture and landscape designed by the same key figures as the nearby Huntington Library.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been the setting for films and television shows including Westworld, Saving Mr. Banks, The Parent Trap and Modern Family.
verified_facts.excerpt: has been the setting to hundreds of films and television shows — including Westworld, Saving Mr. Banks, The Parent Trap, Modern Family, and more.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a quarterly interactive guided film tour through My Valley Pass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our film history with a quarterly interactive guided tour through My Valley Pass.

verified_facts.text: The Langham Club is on the 8th floor and overlooks the Horseshoe Garden, with views of San Marino and the valley beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Langham Club, located on the 8th floor and overlooking the Horseshoe Garden with sweeping views of San Marino and the valley beyond

verified_facts.text: Guests of Club Executive Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of Club Executive Rooms and Suites enjoy complimentary access to The Langham Club, a serene retreat with personalized service.

verified_facts.text: Ford Cottage was a frequent stay of President Gerald Ford and looks onto the Horseshoe Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: President Gerald Ford was a frequent guest of this charming cottage

verified_facts.text: Eastview Cottage was built in 1920 as a second home for Mrs. McNally of Rand McNally atlases.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in 1920, Eastview Cottage originally served as a second home to Mrs. McNally of Rand McNally atlases.

verified_facts.text: Wisteria Cottage was built in 1929 and has a cone-shaped ceiling and French doors that lead to a patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in 1929, our most private and romantic cottage features a unique cone-shaped ceiling, gorgeous living spaces, and French doors that lead to an enchanting patio.

verified_facts.text: The Tournament of Roses Suite is a two-story penthouse with views of the Horseshoe Garden, San Marino and the San Gabriel Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our showstopping two-story penthouse commands 360-degree views of the Horseshoe Garden, San Marino, and the majestic San Gabriel Mountains.

verified_facts.text: Lanai Rooms have large French doors opening onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the historic Lanai Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: large French doors which open onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the historic Lanai Pool.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Pasadena at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, our hotel is located in beautiful Pasadena — a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2025 and 2026.
The hotel's spa has treatments based on traditional Chinese medicine.
verified_facts.excerpt: has treatments based on traditional Chinese medicine.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on 17 acres of greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy The Langham Huntington's 17 acres of lush greenery
